All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
AnimationBackground
This class is responsible for animation in background of main menu.
BadColorFormatException
This exception is thrown when the color format in the .json file is incorrect.
BasicWindow
This class represents a basic window in the game, providing common functionality for all windows.
BoardManager
This class manages the game board, including cell movements, merging, and checking game state.
Cell
This class represents cell in game with value and color that will be used in board in game.
EndWindow
This class represents the end window of the game, which is displayed when the game is over.
FileManager
This class manages file operations related to writing or reading.
Game
This class represents the main game logic.
GameData
This class is used for saving and loading game data like player and board.
GamePanel
This class represents the main game panel where the game board is painted and user inputs are handled.
GameWindow
This class represents the main game window, which displays the game board, score, time and quit, save buttons.
IntroducingWindow
This class represents the introducing window of the game, which is the first window that appears when the game is launched.
Main
 
MovingCell
This class represents a moving cell in the game, which extends the basic Cell class and includes properties for movement and size.
MyColor
This class represents color in game for .json files to be converted into Color objects.
MyKeyAdapter
This class is used for processing key events in game.
Player
This class represents the player in the game, keeping track of score and time.
RandomGenerator
This class is solving all problems with random generating.
StartListener
This interface is used for starting game.
